notes: BIRTHPLACE GARBLED (research 2026-07-03): "Berkhampsted, Suffolk, England (Kent, England)" conflates at least two counties — Berkhamsted is in Hertfordshire, not Suffolk or Kent. No period source found documents his actual English birthplace; compiled genealogies (FamilySearch MMMD-N4K; WikiTree Larkin-46) simply guess. Treat as unsourced speculation, not fact.

WIFE'S MAIDEN NAME DISPUTED (research 2026-07-03): this record's spouse "Joanna Hale" (I182381536282) is not firmly documented — per a Rootsweb/Geni discussion, the only firm fact is that Edward, Robert, and John Larkin each married a woman named Joan/Joanna, and the Larkin, Hale, and Penticost families were closely associated in Charlestown by 1651. "Hale" is plausible but not conclusively documented (an alternative, "Butler," has even less support); label as inferred/disputed. What is well documented: his widow Joanna remarried ropemaker John Penticost after Mar 1657/8, which is the likely source of the "(Penticost)" attached to daughter Hannah's name (I182381536270), not a maiden or married name of her own.
